# DELTA

## Planned versus actual

The plan called for a much more realistic character renderer, realistic office objects, anchored bubbles, dense action, broad camera language, and a new one-minute film. All planned systems were implemented.

## Additional defects discovered and closed

1. The original arm path connected shoulder directly to wrist. Jointed elbow geometry was added.
2. The original leg path connected hip directly to foot. Jointed knee geometry and planted/crouched poses were added.
3. The office environment was a generic interior. A constructed three-layer office set was added.
4. Props were largely symbolic. Material-specific object painters and deterministic motion were added.
5. Dialogue used full-width banners. Speaker-anchored bubbles with tails and safe layout were added.
6. Two authored camera move labels were not supported by the real motion library. The shot file was completely rewritten to use pursuit, crane, crash-zoom, handheld, whip-pan, slow-push, pull-back, and locked vocabulary.
7. The first head scale court sampled the closing title card. The court was rewritten to inspect Rivky's actual 57.5-second reaction frame.
8. Tunnel job receipts repeatedly vanished after transport restarts. Restart-proof repository-side verification logs and exit files were created.
9. Early exporter hashes were captured before artifact finalization. Current media, preview, plan, and exporter-manifest hashes were remeasured and proven identical.

No unresolved delta remains.
